title: Left Ehresmann monoids with a proper basis
summary: Left Ehresmann monoids, and their two-sided counterpart of Ehresmann monoids, were so named by Lawson, who elucidated their connection to the work of Ehresmann in differential geometry. This article is dedicated to building a theory for left Ehresmann monoids inspired by that for inverse semigroups; in order to do so we must develop substantially different ideas and techniques.
